Hulk Hogan's Main Event.name: Hulk Hogan's Main Event
Hulk Hogan's Main Event.summary: Hulk Hogan's Main Event is a professional wrestling fighting game starring Hulk Hogan created by American studio Panic Button and published by Majesco Entertainment for the Xbox 360. The game requires the Kinect peripheral.

Madden NFL 25.name: Madden NFL 25
Madden NFL 25.summary: Madden NFL 25 celebrates 25 years of Madden NFL Football action with Physics You Can Feel from the most authentic NFL game franchise on Earth. EA Sports - It's In The Game.

Operation Darkness.name: Operation Darkness
Operation Darkness.summary: Operation Darkness is a turn-based strategy RPG which follows the exploits of a supernatural special forces unit during World War II as they attempt to stop Hitler and his various occult minions.

Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009.name: Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009
Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009.summary: Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009 is a fishing sports game where players travel to popular freshwater fishing locations and compete in tournaments. The gameplay focuses on casting, reeling, and fighting fish to catch trophy species and perform well under tournament conditions.The game includes multiple modes and locations, with different challenges that emphasize skill-based fishing and trying to land a wide variety of catches.
